_imagery: Where every image came from. State plainly whether it is client supplied, generated, or licensed stock, and where the masters live.
_HONESTY: CAPITALISED section for anything that is a factual claim rather than decoration. Before/after pairs, testimonials attached to portraits, result figures, and third-party assets all belong here. Say what is unverified and what must be confirmed before publishing. Do not delete this key just because it is currently empty - write 'none outstanding'.
_faceBand: For any hero or focal image: the measured rectangle the subject occupies, as fractions of the source. e.g. 'x 58-87%, y 7-32%. Measured off the file, not estimated. Any future crop must keep that rectangle whole.'
_cropStrategy: How the hero survives every breakpoint. Record the cap, the pin side, the mobile fallback, and the widths at which it was verified.
processing: Resized with sharp. Progressive JPEG q82 (mozjpeg) + WebP q80. Note any cropping, and explicitly note where none was applied.

attribution._note: Never invent a photographer. Record null plus the source URL and a note to complete it.

thirdParty._when: Only if assets belong to someone else.
thirdParty.disclaimer: Where the unaffiliated/fan-concept disclaimer appears on the page.
thirdParty.publicRepoWarning: Acceptable in a private repo. Publishing publicly is redistribution - decide deliberately.

unused_supplied: <file> - <what it shows, and why it was not placed>
_beforeDeploying: images/_masters/ is <n> MB and images/_superseded/ is <n> MB. Exclude both from any deployment; only the optimised variants in images/ are referenced by the page.
